description: Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government. - Order under Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2043/56, 2043/57 of 2017.11.02
reasoning: This gazette contains orders amending previous orders related to the constitution of various Municipal Councils and Pradeshiya Sabhas. The content involves legal amendments to electoral boundaries and ward names under specific legislation (Municipal Councils Ordinance and Pradeshiya Sabhas Act), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While a minister is named, this is not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather about exercising statutory powers to make legal amendments to existing regulations.
